paper.abstract_en: We investigate the thermodynamic properties of the Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson black hole, an exact Petrov type D solution of Einstein-Maxwell theory describing a rotating black hole immersed in an external electromagnetic field. While the conserved angular momentum and electric charge can be computed straightforwardly, the conserved mass cannot be obtained through standard integrability methods due to the nontrivial asymptotically uniform external electromagnetic field. To overcome this difficulty, we adopt the Christodoulou-Ruffini mass relation as a thermodynamic definition of the conserved mass, and identify the associated generator, thereby fixing the ambiguity in defining this conserved mass and constructing the thermodynamic potentials. These thermodynamic quantities naturally satisfy the first law of black-hole thermodynamics as well as the Smarr formula.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文深入研究了克尔-贝尔托蒂-罗宾逊黑洞的热力学性质，提出了通过克里斯托杜卢-鲁菲尼质量关系定义守恒质量的方法，并验证了热力学第一定律和斯马尔公式，属于黑洞热力学的重要理论工作。
decision.title_zh: 克尔-贝尔托蒂-罗宾逊黑洞的热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了克尔-贝尔托蒂-罗宾逊黑洞的热力学性质，这是一种爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦理论的精确佩特罗夫D型解，描述了一个浸没在外部电磁场中的旋转黑洞。虽然守恒的角动量和电荷可以直接计算，但由于非渐近平坦的外部电磁场，守恒质量无法通过标准的可积性方法获得。为了克服这一困难，我们采用克里斯托杜卢-鲁菲尼质量关系作为守恒质量的热力学定义，并识别出相应的生成元，从而固定了定义这一守恒质量的歧义性，并构建了热力学势。这些热力学量自然满足黑洞热力学第一定律以及斯马尔公式。
